description: Storm damage on Tinakori Rd, Thorndon
detail: A MetService severe weather warning is active. Multiple trees and power lines are down in the Tinakori Rd area.

description: Severe wind damage on Cuba St, Te Aro
detail: Wind gusts exceeding 120 km/h caused structural damage to awnings and signage. Debris on footpath. Avoid the block.

description: Tree down blocking Majoribanks St, Mt Victoria
detail: A large pohutukawa has fallen across both lanes. The road is closed. WCC Parks crews have been notified.

description: Large tree blocking Aro St, Aro Valley
detail: Storm winds brought down a mature tree blocking the footpath and partially blocking the road. Avoid the area.

description: Strong gusts damaging structures on Miramar Ave
detail: Sustained 90 km/h gusts have damaged fencing and a roof on Miramar Ave. Loose debris remains in the area.

description: Dangerous leaning tree on Ohiro Rd, Brooklyn
detail: A tree is leaning significantly after root damage. It has not fallen but poses a risk. WCC inspection pending.

description: Slip on Karori Rd near tunnel
detail: Soil movement has deposited debris on Karori Rd. The road is closed between Karori Park and the tunnel entrance.

description: Hail damage on Riddiford St, Newtown
detail: Intense hail caused minor flooding and damaged several vehicle windscreens. Roads are clearing but remain slippery.

description: Fallen branch on Upland Rd, Kelburn
detail: A heavy branch has come down on the footpath. Pedestrians should cross to the other side until removed.

description: Slip covering lane on The Parade, Island Bay
detail: A significant slip has covered one lane of The Parade with mud and debris. One lane remains open under traffic control.

description: Road flooding on The Parade, Island Bay
detail: The Parade is flooded to a depth of approximately 30 cm following heavy rain and a storm surge. Road is closed.

description: Surface flooding on Constable St, Newtown
detail: Overland flooding has entered several ground-floor properties. The overland flowpath is at capacity. Avoid the area.

description: Slip on Happy Valley Rd, Brooklyn
detail: A minor slip has deposited material on the road shoulder. One lane is passable. Further movement is possible.

description: Road subsidence on Karori Rd
detail: Significant road subsidence has made a section of Karori Rd unstable. The affected lane is closed pending repair.

description: Slip on Ruahine St, Hataitai
detail: Soil has slipped from a bank onto the footpath. The footpath is closed; use the road edge with care.

description: Surface flooding on Taranaki St, Te Aro
detail: Stormwater is ponding at the Taranaki St / Courtenay Pl intersection. Passable but slow down and watch for depth.

description: Burst water main on Upland Rd, Kelburn
detail: A major water main has burst, cutting supply to approximately 200 homes. Wellington Water crews are on site.

description: Large pothole on Courtenay Pl, Te Aro
detail: A pothole approximately 40 cm wide and 15 cm deep has opened in the left lane. It has been marked but not yet filled.

description: Pipe leak on Tinakori Rd, Thorndon
detail: A pressurised pipe is leaking under the road surface. The area is partially closed. Expect supply interruptions.

description: Stream overflow on Karori Rd
detail: The Kaiwharawhara Stream has overflowed its banks slightly, depositing water on the road edge. Monitor for changes.

description: Footpath subsidence on Adelaide Rd, Newtown
detail: A section of footpath has sunk by around 10 cm, likely due to a water leak below. Cones are in place.

description: Low pressure on Adelaide Rd, Newtown
detail: Residents are reporting unusually low water pressure. Wellington Water is investigating a possible network fault.

description: Discoloured water on Campbell St, Karori
detail: Tap water appears brown or cloudy following works nearby. Do not drink until Wellington Water clears the line.

description: Cracked footpath on Moorefield Rd, Johnsonville
detail: Tree root damage has cracked and lifted a footpath slab. A trip hazard exists. Reported to WCC for scheduling.
